# DefinitionReadOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options for reading a definition into a document.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core/definition`. Extends `ValidateOptions`.

## Properties

- [`passwords`](#passwords): Passwords for `settings.encryption`.
- [`rasterizer`](#rasterizer): An SVG rasterizer to register on the document.
- [`resources`](#resources): Supplies the bytes for a resource that has a `ref`.

### `passwords`

```typescript
passwords?: { owner?: string; user?: string; } | undefined
```

*optional*

Passwords for `settings.encryption`. They are never part of a definition.

### `rasterizer`

```typescript
rasterizer?: SvgRasterizer | undefined
```

*optional*

An SVG rasterizer to register on the document. Supplied by the host, never stored.

### `resources`

```typescript
resources?: ((ref: string, request: DefinitionResourceRequest) => Uint8Array | undefined | Promise<Uint8Array | undefined>) | undefined
```

*optional*

Supplies the bytes for a resource that has a `ref`. The reader never opens a path or fetches a URL on its own: `ref` is an opaque name the host resolves. Return `undefined` when the host has nothing under that name.
